observations: Observed Val-rep results. Unfinished runs are missing; no conclusions are inferred.

conv_draft_comparison.observations: Observed gains subtract each run and domain's own y0. Means require three seeds; sample standard deviations use ddof=1.

b_comparison.observations: Observed Val-rep scores and paired-depth differences within each run; mean and sample standard deviation require all three seeds. Val-sel proxy is the selected checkpoint best_score, not the Val-rep proxy.
